regime.skew: call-side rich near ATM (-1.58), near-money put bid paid down hard
regime.label: Dealer short gamma across the entire 950-1150 grid for a 7th session, with the downside-protection burden unwinding into a 12.9-point rebound
evidence: -7,476 net GEX (gamma x OI x 200) across the grid and -3,754 in the 990-1010 ATM band, with cumulative net GEX negative at every one of the 21 strikes: no gamma flip exists in the chain, so dealers hedge with the move at every quoted level.

+351 net GEX at 1030, +607 at 1040 and +1,013 at 1050 - per-strike gamma turns positive only on the 1030-1050 shelf, making the 25.4-point gap from 1004.6 up to max pain 1030 a short-gamma runway that gets damped on arrival, not before.

-760 total OI (35,408 to 34,648) for a second consecutive session on -58% volume (9,049 to 3,808 contracts), with the 960 put wall shedding 453 OI on 490 lots: the heavy put volume was closing, the Unwind signature, not new insurance.

-3.42 to -5.78 vol points on the 1010-1040 puts (1020 put 15.65% to 11.28%, 1040 put 16.44% to 10.66%) swinging 25-delta skew 2.48 points to -1.58 from +0.90 - the downside bid that financed the slide has been paid down.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,004.6 anchor, +12.9 (+1.30%) - a 1.44-sigma day against an 8.97-point 1-sigma - clawing back 13.3 of the prior session's 27-point slide to 991.3. 1.50 P/C volume ratio, the highest of the 10-session window and up from 0.58, yet total OI still fell 760 to 34,648 and put OI 335 to 15,484: the heavy put flow was closing, not insuring. Max pain holds 1030 for a second session, 25.4 points above spot, and the 1030-1050 shelf is the only positive-gamma zone in the chain. 25-delta skew flipped to -1.58 (970 put 13.83% vs 1030 call 15.41%) from +0.90 as near-money put IV was crushed 2.4-5.8 points.
what_changed: Anchor jumped 12.9 points to 1,004.6 (+1.30%), a 1.44-sigma session, after -27 the session before - the 1,004.6 close sits 25.4 points under max pain 1030 and 44.6 points over the 960 put wall.

P/C volume ratio spiked to 1.50 from 0.58 (2,282 put vs 1,526 call lots) - window high - but put OI fell 335 and the 960 wall lost 453 contracts on 490 lots, so the flow failed the Vol2Vol test for new protection.

Near-money put IV collapsed: 1010 put 14.94% to 11.52%, 1020 15.65% to 11.28%, 1040 16.44% to 10.66%, dragging 25-delta skew 2.48 points call-rich to -1.58 and both 25-delta bands 10 points higher (put 960 to 970, call 1020 to 1030).

Net GEX improved 20.8% to -7,476 from -9,434 and the ATM band to -3,754 from -5,631, but the 1050 near call wall shed 239 OI on only 130 lots and the 1100 call wall (2,764 OI, 9.5% above spot) traded 46 lots - both stale.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The anchor is still 21.6 points below the 1,026.2 print of 11-03 despite today's bounce, and max pain has drifted 20 points down with it (1050 to 1040 on 11-04 to 1030 on 11-07), so the magnet has been chasing price rather than holding it - it now sits 25.4 points above spot. ATM IV expanded 1.94 points over the window (12.24% to 14.18%, a window high) and the 1-sigma day widened 13.4% from 7.91 to 8.97 points: this is vol expansion, not the compression that would hand premium sellers an edge. Open interest built 26.9% across the five sessions (27,295 to 34,648) with call OI +40.3% against put OI +13.5%, pulling the P/C OI ratio from 0.9985 to 0.808 - and the last two sessions have now reversed 760 of that build. The gamma flip has been absent from the grid since the 10-31 GEX sign flip, meaning dealers have amplified every move for seven straight sessions and the 950-1150 ladder has no dampening zone below 1030. Net: the amplifier is still wired, the protection that was paid for it is being sold back, and both 25-delta bands have reset 10 points higher for the first time in the window.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1010 / 1030
strategies.rationale: The 1,004.6-to-1030 gap is pure short-gamma runway (-445 net GEX at 1010, -869 at 1020, turning +351 only at 1030), so dealer re-hedging pushes with an upside continuation until price reaches max pain 1030 - heatmap-zones.md's squeeze mechanic, capped at the strike where the dampening shelf begins.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 7.6 points net debit (1010 call 18.5 ask - 1030 call 10.9 bid), max gain 12.4 points, breakeven 1,017.6.
strategies.invalidation: A close back below 991.3 (the prior session's low anchor) voids the continuation; the structure also loses its edge above 1030 where per-strike gamma turns positive.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1000 / 980
strategies.rationale: Downside convexity is now the cheap wing - the 1000 put is marked at 12.21% IV against 16.15% on the 1000 call and 15.41% on the 1030 call, a 3.2-to-3.9-point discount created by today's put unwind - and with no gamma flip below 1030 any renewed slide gets amplified, not cushioned (volatility-skew.md, heatmap-zones.md).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.2 points net debit (1000 put 19.2 ask - 980 put 11.0 bid), max gain 11.8 points, breakeven 991.8.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1030 (max pain and the start of the positive-gamma shelf) breaks the downside-amplification thesis.

S50Z26.prediction: 1030 is the hinge: below it dealers are short gamma at every strike and amplify direction, so the 25.4-point gap to max pain is the path of least resistance while today's 1.44-sigma rebound holds, and 1030-1050 is where that push gets damped (+351 to +1,013 net GEX). A loss of 1,000 re-opens 980 and 970 and then the 960 wall, which at 3,098 OI is 4.4% away and inside the Vol2Vol proximity band for the first time this window - but it shed 453 contracts today, so it is a thinning floor, not a defended one. The Unwind zone's own prescription is to reduce engagement rather than add it: -760 OI and -58% volume mean the next real move waits on new flow, and a close above 1030 invalidates the short-gamma amplification bias outright.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no recommendation to execute any trade. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1030 as a tendency, not a target, especially at 49 DTE where ATM gamma is nowhere near its expiry spike. Defined risk is not risk-free - the 7.6-point and 8.2-point debits are real and can be lost in full. The 1100 call wall (2,764 OI, 9.5% above spot, 46 lots) and the 1050 near call wall (1,909 OI, -239 today on 130 lots) both fail the Vol2Vol test and should not be weighted as live magnets, and the 1050 put (5.95% IV) and 1060 put (15.40% vs 0.00% prior) marks are unreliable prints excluded from the skew read. Macro or news flow can override the option structure entirely.
